Name: Add Tuxedo Cat as Pet
Author: Pearstar37
Description:
The tuxedo cat can appear as one of the adoptable pets at the start of a new save (if you selected that option), or you can purchase it later from Marnie’s animal shop.To install, download and extract the mod file under your Mods folder.

﻿奶牛猫可以在新存档开始时作为可领养的宠物之一出现（如果你选择了该选项），或者你可以在稍后从玛妮的宠物店购买它。安装方法：将zip文件下载并解压到你的Mods文件夹中。

june 28 update: fixed some issues, now the cat can wander around in your farm!! please note that this mod has a very fucked up internal logic that treates the tuxedo cat as a kind of new pet aside from cat and dog, which means the adoption event is rewritten. For those who are not using English or Mandarin in Stardew Valley, your language may not appear for the tuxedo cat adoption event (which actually is the same thing as the cat adoption.)

6.28: 修改了一些bug，现在奶牛猫会像正常的猫一样在农场走动。

Downloads.Description: fixed minor issues, now the cat is able to wander around in the farm.
